meta.title: WaveFlux — waveform-first desktop audio player
meta.description: A desktop audio player for Windows and Linux with waveform navigation, local library tools, playlists, tracker modules and metadata editing.

hero.title: Desktop audio player with waveform navigation
hero.description: Browse a local library, move through tracks by waveform, manage playlists and play tracker modules in one focused desktop application.

showcase.title: Your library stays in view
showcase.description: The main player, detailed settings and compact controls share the same direct visual language.

mainPlayer.title: Main player
mainPlayer.description: Waveform navigation, playlist context and playback controls in one window.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Playback, appearance and integration options grouped by task.

compact.title: Compact mode
compact.description: Essential transport controls and track context in a smaller surface.

features.title: Tools for local listening workflows
features.description: WaveFlux combines playback, library organization and audio utilities without moving your collection to a cloud service.

waveform.title: Waveform navigation
waveform.description: Scrub and zoom through cached peaks, with a dedicated fullscreen waveform mode.

playback.title: Continuous playback
playback.description: Gapless flow, queue, repeat, deterministic shuffle and session restore keep playback predictable.

trackers.title: Native tracker modules
trackers.description: OpenMPT playback for .669, .mod, .xm, .s3m and .it with seek, waveform, spectrum and session restore.

equalizer.title: 10-band equalizer
equalizer.description: Use built-in presets or import and export your own equalizer settings.

playlists.title: Flexible playlists
playlists.description: Import files, folders, URLs, XSPF and CUE; export playlists as M3U, M3U8 or JSON.

urlImport.title: Audio import from URL
urlImport.description: Probe sources with yt-dlp, choose a format and review retries and import results.

converter.title: Audio converter
converter.description: Convert single tracks or batches with format validation, profiles and speed or pitch controls.

tags.title: Metadata editing
tags.description: Edit one track or a batch, including cover art where the audio format supports it.

library.title: Smart local library
library.description: SQLite-backed collections and field-aware search keep large libraries navigable.

desktop.title: Desktop integration
desktop.description: Use SMTC on Windows and MPRIS with XDG portals on supported Linux desktops.

appearance.title: Adaptable interface
appearance.description: Choose light or dark appearance, a custom accent and normal or compact player modes.

languages.title: English and Russian
languages.description: The application interface and core workflows are available in both languages.

downloads.title: Choose a build for your system
downloads.description: Use a Windows installer or portable archive, an AppImage, or a native package for your Linux distribution.
requirements: Windows 10 or newer, or a recent Linux desktop distribution.
A working audio stack: Windows audio services, PipeWire or PulseAudio on Linux.
Linux packages may require Qt 6, KDE Frameworks 6, GStreamer, TagLib and libopenmpt depending on the package format.

windowsPortable.title: Portable archive
windowsPortable.description: Run WaveFlux from an extracted folder.

appImage.title: AppImage
appImage.description: Portable Linux build without system installation.

debian.title: Debian package
debian.description: Package for Debian, Ubuntu and compatible systems.

rpm.title: RPM package
rpm.description: Package for Fedora and compatible systems.

arch.title: Arch package
arch.description: Build recipe and package support for Arch Linux.

trust.title: Inspect the code. Keep your library private.
trust.description: WaveFlux is released under the MIT license. Update checks read public release metadata and do not send library contents, file paths, playlists or user settings.
trust.privacyDescription: Only technical update metadata such as the last check time, ETag and skipped release is stored.

footer.summary: Waveform-first local audio playback for Windows and Linux.
footer.copyright: © {year} WaveFlux contributors. Released under the MIT license.
